1: Beshak maine Quran ko ek hi baar duniya ke sab se qareeb aasman tak utara, jis tarah maine usey Muhammad ﷺ par utarna shuru kiya, Ramzan ke maheene mein Laylat-ul-Qadr ko.
2: Aey Nabi ﷺ, kya aap jaante hain ke is raat mein kaisi bhalai aur barkat hai?
3: Yeh raat bari bhalai ki raat hai; woh us shaks ke liye ek hazaar maheenon se behtar hai jo us mein iman ke saath aur ajr ki umeed rakh kar namaz mein khara ho.
4: Us mein farishte aur Jibreel (alaihis salaam) apne Rubb ki ijazat se utarte hain, jo paak hai, aur har woh maamla le kar aate hain jo Allah ne us saal ke liye muqarrar kiya ho, chahe woh rizq ho, mautein, paidaishein ya koi aur cheez jo us ne muqarrar ki.
5: Yeh poori mubarak raat bhalai se bhari hui hai, apne aagaz se le kar apne anjaam tak, subah phootne tak.
